## NPSphere 0.64.2

**New**
- **Duplicate** button on the survey screen. The copy includes the settings, the questions (conditional rules included) and the email templates. It leaves out the target audience, the answers and the sending history, and it starts **inactive**.

**Fixes**
- Public survey on phones: the phone number field no longer gets squeezed next to the country.
- The "your answer was recorded" message after clicking in an email no longer breaks into columns.

**Since 0.64.0**
- Cleaner Template tab: field help in ⓘ icons, and a new Help sub-tab.
- Answers by email link are now recorded reliably for people who are not logged in (0.64.1).
- New surveys default to "several answers: no" and "anonymous: no" (0.64.1).

Tested end to end on GLPI 11.0.11 (MariaDB 10.11, PHP 8.3). Upgrades from 0.50.0 onwards produce the same database as a fresh install.

**Install:** extract `npsphere-0.64.2.zip` into GLPI's `marketplace/` (or `plugins/`) folder, then go to **Setup › Plugins**.

Full history (in Portuguese): [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MichaelRodriguesOficial/NPS-GLPi/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
